item.title: Justin Bieber Makes 2026 NHL Draft Appearance, Announces Toronto Maple Leafs’ No. 1 Pick
item.description:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending, the podcast where we bring you the latest buzz in entertainment. I'm your host, and today we're talking about a very special night for one of music's biggest stars, Justin Bieber.
On Friday, June 26th, Justin made a surprise appearance at the 2026 NHL Draft at the KeyBank Center in Buffalo, New York. But he wasn't there to perform - he was there to announce the number one draft pick for his lifelong favorite hockey team, the Toronto Maple Leafs.
[Clip of crowd cheering plays]
Host: "Justin was introduced by NHL commissioner Gary Bettman, who called him one of the team's 'most diehard and iconic fans.' And Justin's excitement was palpable as he took the stage. He even shared that he's been a Leafs fan since he was a little boy.
[Clip of Justin Bieber speaking plays]
Host: "The crowd's reaction was mixed, but that didn't dampen Justin's mood. He went on to announce that Penn State's Gavin McKenna had been drafted to the Leafs, and even posed for photos with the new player onstage. McKenna walked out to Justin's song 'Yukon' - a fitting choice, given that McKenna is from Whitehorse, Yukon.
[Clip of music plays]
Host: "And in other news, Friday also marked the release of Justin's new live album, 'Swag Live From Coachella'. The 22-track recording features guest spots from The Kid LAROI, Tems, Wizkid, Dijon, and Mk.gee. You can check it out now via Def Jam.
[Music continues to play]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
[Music fades out]
